text: UI-G G1 is on main (8ebd30f). Take line numbers only from core RecordLines, never from String.lines() or an editor split: core counts only LF as a line end, and a lone CR is not a break. The record-to-lines lookup is span(record); owner(line) returns RecordRole with no offset (offset = line − span(record).first). A LineOwner with an offset is not needed for S6.4. DataRecord and FixationNumber use the tagged codecs from record-identity-v1.json.
